principle.name: CADENCE CHANGES SPACING WITHOUT RESETTING SUPPORT PHASE
principle.summary: Coil on the current support, expand root gaps through surge without resetting L/R phase, then collapse gaps through probe/acquire/absorb and finish with displaced recovery debt.

keys.causal_role: establish left support and forward debt without a neutral pose

keys.name: WALK_LEFT_TOE_ROLL
keys.motion_arc_root_note: pelvis (11,17): only +2 x; torso gets ahead before stride length grows
keys.causal_role: roll through trusted left foot while free leg folds under COM

keys.name: RIGHT_FOOT_SEARCH

keys.name: RIGHT_FOOT_ACQUIRE

keys.name: RIGHT_COIL_FOR_SURGE

keys.causal_role: store acceleration on the same right support phase instead of phase-resetting

keys.name: RIGHT_DRIVE_SPIKE
keys.motion_arc_root_note: pelvis (20,16): +4 x and -3 y in one authored release; right foot still owns the push
keys.causal_role: convert coil into root acceleration before support leaves

keys.name: FIRST_FLIGHT_TRAIL
keys.motion_arc_root_note: pelvis (25,14): +5 x; root rises after the right-foot release, not before it

keys.name: LEFT_PRECONTACT_LONG

keys.causal_role: project left foot ahead without claiming support early

keys.name: LEFT_CATCH_FAST
keys.motion_arc_root_note: pelvis (36,16): +5 x and +2 y; left catch absorbs rather than teleporting root flat
keys.causal_role: first fast catch preserves the alternating phase and converts flight to support

keys.name: LEFT_CATCH_ABSORB
keys.motion_arc_root_note: pelvis (38,18): +2 x while dropping 2; acceleration pauses inside support absorption
keys.causal_role: compress the fast landing before the next drive

keys.name: LEFT_DRIVE_WHIP
keys.motion_arc_root_note: pelvis (43,15): +5 x and -3 y; left support fires the second surge

keys.name: SECOND_FLIGHT_OPEN
keys.motion_arc_root_note: pelvis (49,13): +6 x; highest forward spacing of the surge
keys.causal_role: carry left-support release into a distinctly asymmetric flight before the right-foot reach

keys.name: RIGHT_PRECONTACT_REACH
keys.motion_arc_root_note: pelvis (56,14): +7 x; maximum stride spacing occurs before the right catch
keys.causal_role: project next foot far enough that speed is visible as distance, not just timing

keys.name: RIGHT_CATCH_SURGE
keys.motion_arc_root_note: pelvis (62,16): +6 x and +2 y; right catch accepts the long flight without phase reset
keys.causal_role: trusted right support catches peak speed

keys.name: RIGHT_STIFF_SPRING
keys.motion_arc_root_note: pelvis (65,17): +3 x; short compression preserves speed while changing vertical arc
keys.causal_role: stiffen the support spring so next flight is lower and faster

keys.name: RIGHT_DRIVE_LOW
keys.motion_arc_root_note: pelvis (70,15): +5 x; lower launch begins the transition from surge to brake preparation
keys.causal_role: drive one more right support rather than inserting an artificial cadence reset

keys.name: LEFT_CATCH_RUNOUT
keys.motion_arc_root_note: pelvis (76,16): +6 x; left foot catches the last long stride before braking
keys.causal_role: complete the existing R→L phase before deceleration begins

keys.name: LEFT_BRAKE_COIL
keys.motion_arc_root_note: pelvis (78,19): only +2 x while dropping 3; stride spacing collapses before support order changes
keys.causal_role: turn the trusted left catch into a braking coil, not an idle pose

keys.name: LEFT_BRAKE_RELEASE
keys.motion_arc_root_note: pelvis (81,17): +3 x and -2 y; remaining momentum rebounds out of compression
keys.causal_role: release from left brake support into a deliberately shorter flight

keys.name: SHORT_FLIGHT_BRAKE
keys.motion_arc_root_note: pelvis (84,16): only +3 x; airborne distance has visibly collapsed from +6/+7
keys.causal_role: release left support but keep the same next-right phase

keys.name: RIGHT_HEEL_PROBE
keys.motion_arc_root_note: pelvis (85,17): +1 x; probe reaches ahead while COM remains behind it
keys.causal_role: make the right heel contact visible without granting support yet

keys.name: RIGHT_HEEL_ACQUIRE
keys.motion_arc_root_note: pelvis (86,18): +1 x; right heel earns ownership before deep deceleration
keys.causal_role: transfer L→R phase through an explicit probe/acquire event

keys.name: RIGHT_BRAKE_DEEP
keys.motion_arc_root_note: pelvis (86,20): zero x and +2 y; velocity is paid into compression instead of snapping to rest
keys.causal_role: absorb the remaining forward debt on the same right support

keys.name: LEFT_RECOVERY_PROBE
keys.motion_arc_root_note: pelvis (85,19): root rebounds one cell backward while left foot probes under COM
keys.causal_role: show overshoot/settle debt before changing support again

keys.name: LEFT_RECOVERY_ACQUIRE
keys.motion_arc_root_note: pelvis (84,18): another -1 x settle; left support catches the braking rebound
keys.causal_role: acquire left foot after probe and release the right brake foot

keys.name: TORSO_OVERSHOOT_LEFT
keys.motion_arc_root_note: pelvis (85,17): +1 x rebound while chest passes ahead; left foot remains owner
keys.causal_role: let upper-body inertia overshoot after root velocity has largely died

keys.name: RIGHT_STEP_SEARCH
keys.motion_arc_root_note: pelvis (86,17): +1 x; recovery resumes small travel instead of returning to idle
keys.causal_role: search for the next right step while left still owns support

keys.name: RIGHT_RECOVERY_STEP
keys.motion_arc_root_note: pelvis (88,17): +2 x; displaced recovery step catches residual travel
keys.causal_role: transfer L→R and prove the cadence can continue after braking

keys.name: EXIT_WALK_WITH_DEBT
keys.motion_arc_root_note: pelvis (89,17): endpoint stays displaced; head and free left foot both project into the next stride while right foot sti
keys.causal_role: leave the frame with visible left-step debt instead of resolving to an upright idle
